allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5180/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 8; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)"; if \($r.Content -match 'src=./src/main.jsx.'\) { 'main.jsx present' }; if \($r.Content -match 'Codex'\) { 'title Codex present' } } catch { "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'vite' -and $_.CommandLine -match '5180' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; 'old dev server stopped')
PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5180/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 6; "Dev server UP — HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "DOWN: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
